results.title: Upload Methods
results.body:
Summary: Some items have specialized pathways to make things easier and quicker (especially if you have a lot of items to upload) or if you are contributing them to other platforms (such as Envato Elements).

Please note: It is encouraged for new authors to review the how-to-upload instructions first before reviewing the information below. This article is only for those who have specialized pathways or who need to select their items to sell on another Envato platform, like Envato Elements.

Select your Item Type

  • Audio

    Most audio items can be uploaded through your Author Dashboard on AudioJungle. For how to do this, see: How To Upload Your Items to Envato. Here, we explain the specialized pathways if you need them, or how to get your audio items to Elements. Select below:

    Music on Envato Elements

    Sound Effects on Envato Elements

    FTP Upload for Audio

    Music on Envato Elements

    Please follow the steps below for selecting Music Tracks (excluding Sound Effects items), to sell on Envato Elements.

    1. Music tracks must first be published to AudioJungle on Envato Market.
    2. Items can then be opted-in for Envato Elements on the item 'edit' page. To do this, navigate to your portfolio page and click on the item that you would like to add to the Elements library. Once on the item page, click ‘edit.’
    3. Once on the Market item edit page, click the ‘Elements’ tab and check the Elements License checkbox. This box gives permission for the item to be made available on Envato Elements.
    4. Scroll to the bottom of the tab and click Save Changes.

    Once you have completed the outlined steps, your items will appear on Envato Elements and be available for sale to Elements customers.

    Remember - you need to first be approved as an Envato Elements author. We are not currently accepting Audio applications for Envato Elements.

    Sound Effects on Envato Elements

    1. Items must first be published to AudioJungle on Envato Market.
    2. SFX items are then transferred to Elements automatically - don't worry, we will do this for you!

    Remember - you need to first be approved as an Envato Elements author. We are not currently accepting Audio applications for Envato Elements.

    FTP Upload for Audio

    Please follow these steps:

    1. Open your FTP client and enter the following details:
    Host: ftp.marketplace.envato.com
    Username: [your Envato username] (this is case-sensitive)
    Password: [your Envato API key]
    Port: 21
    Encryption: Use explicit FTP over TLS
    Click 'Connect' or your FTP client equivalent.

    2. Drag your files into the upload area of the FTP client. Do not place your files in the folder marked "bulk_import".

    3. Wait for your files to process, and then close your FTP client.

    4. Go to your Envato Market Author Dashboard and navigate to the upload page. Your files will be there waiting, ready to be entered into the upload form and submitted.

    Please Note: All FTP uploads will remain in the system for 24 hours only, at which point they are automatically removed. Please ensure you submit your items for review within 24 hours of beginning the FTP upload process.

    *Need help? Check out the FTP troubleshooting guide in section 12 of the Uploading FAQ’s.

  • Video

    How you upload video items depends on whether you are submitting Stock Video (Stock Footage and Motion Graphics) or Video Templates.

    Video Templates

    You can upload video templates to Envato Market through your Author Dashboard on VideoHive. For how to do this, see: How To Upload Your Items to Envato. 

    Video Templates on Elements 

    Please follow the steps below for selecting Video Templates to sell on Envato Elements.

    1. Video Templates must first be published to VideoHive on Envato Market.
    2. Items can then be opted-in for Envato Elements on the item 'edit' page. To do this, navigate to your portfolio page and click on the item that you would like to add to the Elements library. Once on the item page, click ‘edit.’
    3. Once on the Market item edit page, click the ‘Elements’ tab and check the Elements License checkbox. This box gives permission for the item to be made available on Envato Elements.

    4. On the item edit page, click the next tab ‘Update Description & Price.’ In the Text Description field, provide your item description using the following basic markdown shown below:

    You will also need to add your Audio attribution here in the Text Description field, if you have used an AudioJungle Track in your Item preview. Write the AudioJungle author's username and the Item ID.

    5. Upload a high-resolution preview image and please note the following dimensions:

    • Recommended size: 2560 x 1440
    • Minimum size requirement: 1920 x 1080 (16:9)

    6. Scroll to the bottom of the tab and click Save Changes.

    Once you have completed the outlined steps, your items will appear on Envato Elements and be available for download by Elements customers.

    Remember - you need to first be approved as an Envato Elements author.

    Stock Video

    This guide will walk you through preparing and uploading your stock footage or motion graphics using the Portfolio Manager.

    Before You Begin: Requirements & Metadata

    To ensure your stock videos are approved successfully, you must meet our technical and content requirements. Please review our guide on Video Item Preparation & Technical Requirements before you start.

    Technical Requirements Checklist

    An item cannot be submitted for review until it meets these minimum requirements:

    • A Title (under 100 characters)
    • A Description
    • Keywords (at least 1, no more than 50)
    • Price set for both Single Use and Multi-use Licenses
    • QuickTime MOV or MP4 file, using Photo JPEG, H.264 or ProRes encoding
    • Resolution of 1920x1080, 2K or 4K (8K also accepted for Stock Footage)
    • For Stock Footage, minimum 5 seconds of usable footage

    Metadata

    Technical specifications (resolution, frame rate, encoding, clip count and duration) are automatically read from your video file, unless you are uploading as a ZIP. If you submit your item as a ZIP, these specifications won't be auto-detected and you will need to enter them manually.

    Bulk CSV Metadata
    As noted in our Portfolio Manager guides, you are able to use a CSV file to attach metadata to several items at once.

    The Stock Video CSV file requires specific inputs to match the metadata to the appropriate item, so we recommend checking the below table to ensure you've completed the CSV correctly.

    Click here to view CSV Metadata File Formatting & Headers Table

    For an example of the stock video CSV, click here. 

    Uploading items to Portfolio Manager

    Once you've met the requirements above, you can follow these steps to submit your items to Portfolio Manager:

    To submit your items using Portfolio Manager:

    1. Sign in to Portfolio Manager (https://portfolio.envato.com/).
    2. Upload your items by browsing files or using the Drag and drop feature.
    3. Select Edit on your uploaded item to complete the required metadata fields.
    4. When your items are ready to submit, tick the agreement box confirming you hold all necessary legal rights and valid releases.
    5. Select Submit to send your item for review.

    See our guide on How to Upload and Submit in the new Portfolio Manager for step-by-step instructions on uploading, editing and submitting your items.

    Uploading items via FTP

    To upload stock video items via FTP, please follow the below steps. 

    Please note: you will need to have an FTP client installed before following the processes below. We recommend FileZilla’s FTP client and have documented the process using this third-party software. However, you may be more familiar with and are welcome to use an alternative FTP client.

    You’ll need an API key to use as your password for FTP upload. If you haven’t got this yet, simply:

    • Visit https://build.envato.com/create-token/
    • Choose a token name
    • In the permissions list below, make sure to check ‘View and search Envato sites’ and ‘View your Envato Account username’.
    • Then, click Create Token

    Please follow this process for Stock Footage and Motion Graphics Items.

    1. Open your FTP client and enter the following details:

    • Host: http://ftp.aws.portfolio.envato.com/ 
    • Username: [your Envato username] (this is case-sensitive)
    • Password: [your Envato API key]
    • Port: 21
    • Encryption: Use explicit FTP over TLS
    • Click 'Connect' or your FTP client equivalent.

    2. Drag your files into the upload area of the FTP client. There will be designated folders for the specific content type you are uploading - please ensure you upload to this folder specifically. You can also upload your metadata CSV this way. 

    3. Wait for your files to process, and then close your FTP client.

    4. Return to Portfolio Manager to review your uploaded files.

  • Themes and Code

    All Theme and Code items can be uploaded through your Author Dashboard on either ThemeForest or CodeCanyon. For how to do this, see: How To Upload Your Items to Envato. Here, we explain how to get your Web and Code items to Envato Elements. Select below:

    Web and Code items on Envato Elements

    Template Kits on Envato Elements

    Web and Code items on Envato Elements

    Web and code items are integrated between ThemeForest on Envato Market and Envato Elements to make the experience of contributing CMS & HTML Templates to Elements easier.

    This works by entering your specific item ID from ThemeForest or CodeCanyon to create a link between the two items, and then bringing across the zip asset file and live preview URL in the Elements App.

    The CMS Templates Item Type on Elements includes the following categories:

    • Drupal
    • Instapage
    • Joomla
    • Magento
    • Muse
    • OpenCart
    • PrestaShop
    • Shopify
    • Unbounce
    • WordPress

    The Web Templates Item Type on Elements includes the following categories:

    • Site Templates
    • Landing Page Templates

    There are two separate Item Types for Admin or Email Templates:

    • Admin Templates
    • Email Templates

    Given the complex nature of these items they must be approved by the ThemeForest or CodeCanyon review teams and exist on Envato Market.

    Please follow the detailed steps below to contribute your web and code items from Envato Market to Envato Elements:

    1. Login to Elements Author with your Envato account.
    2. Head over to your My Items dashboard.
    3. Select CMS Templates, Web Templates, Admin Templates or Email Templates from the Item Type dropdown.
    4. Input the ThemeForest Item ID for the item you wish to contribute to Elements (the item ID can be located in the item URL - e.g. https://themeforest.net/item/item-name/12345678
    5. Select the Create Item button to begin the upload process.
    6. The zip file asset and the live preview URL will both be transported over to Elements via integration with ThemeForest. As a result, these two assets are not editable during upload (when you update the items zip asset on ThemeForest the update will also flow through to Envato Elements).
    7. Only the zip asset file and live preview URL are inserted via the link with Envato Market. Fill in all other required details as accurately as you can and pay strict attention to our Quality Expectations. More specifically, please consider how you can best present your items on Envato Elements.

    It is a requirement that items of these types exist on ThemeForest, however that does not mean you should contribute all of your items to Envato Elements. Please avoid older items and focus on your modern, clean and well-presented templates.

    A note on author collaboration and partnerships: We're aware that some authors on ThemeForest collaborate or obtain permission from the original designer to create new items with the original author's design. Please keep in mind that Elements is a separate platform to Envato Market and it is your responsibility to ensure you have the rights to list your item on Elements as per the Author Agreement.

    Template Kits on Envato Elements

    1. Items must first be published to ThemeForest on Envato Market.
    2. Template Kits are then transferred to Elements automatically - don't worry, we will do this for you!

    Remember - you need to first be approved as an Envato Elements author. 

  • Graphics

    Please note that your ability to upload specific graphic categories on Envato Elements is dependent on the category you have applied for - for example, if you were approved to sell Graphic Templates, you may not be able to upload fonts.

    This guide will walk you through preparing and uploading your Envato Elements graphics items using the Portfolio Manager. 

    Before You Begin: Requirements & Metadata

    To ensure your graphics items are approved successfully, you must meet our technical and content requirements. Please review our guides in the Graphics Requirements section before you start.

    Technical Requirements Checklist

    An item cannot be submitted for review until it meets these minimum requirements:

    • A Title (under 100 characters)
    • A Description
    • At least 1 and no more than 50 Author Tags
    • Category
    • The file format and technical requirements for your category, listed below

    How to Upload Graphics

    Once you've met the requirements above, you can follow these steps to submit your items to Portfolio Manager:

    1. Sign in to Portfolio Manager (https://portfolio.envato.com/).
    2. Upload your items by browsing files or using the Drag and drop feature.
    3. Select Edit on your uploaded item to complete the required metadata fields.
    4. When your items are ready to submit, tick the agreement box confirming you hold all necessary legal rights and valid releases.
    5. Select Submit to send your item for review.

    See our guide on How to Upload and Submit in the new Portfolio Manager for step-by-step instructions on uploading, editing and submitting your items.

    Uploading items via FTP

    To upload graphics items via FTP, please follow the below steps. Please note, this is not currently available for 3D on Elements, or animated graphics. 

    Please note: you will need to have an FTP client installed before following the processes below. We recommend FileZilla’s FTP client and have documented the process using this third-party software. However, you may be more familiar with and are welcome to use an alternative FTP client.

    You’ll need an API key to use as your password for FTP upload. If you haven’t got this yet, simply:

    • Visit https://build.envato.com/create-token/
    • Choose a token name
    • In the permissions list below, make sure to check ‘View and search Envato sites’ and ‘View your Envato Account username’.
    • Then, click Create Token

    Once you have done this, please follow the below steps.

    1. Open your FTP client and enter the following details:

    • Host: http://ftp.aws.portfolio.envato.com/ 
    • Username: [your Envato username] (this is case-sensitive)
    • Password: [your Envato API key]
    • Port: 21
    • Encryption: Use explicit FTP over TLS
    • Click 'Connect' or your FTP client equivalent.

    2. Drag your files into the upload area of the FTP client. There will be designated folders for the specific content type you are uploading - please ensure you upload to this folder specifically. 

    3. Wait for your files to process, and then close your FTP client.

    4. Return to Portfolio Manager to review your uploaded files.

    Upload Graphic Items to GraphicRiver (Envato Market)

    If you wish to upload your Graphic items to GraphicRiver (not Envato Elements), use your Author Dashboard on Envato Market. For instructions, please see our article: How To Upload Your Items to Envato.

  • Photos

    This guide will walk you through preparing and uploading your photos using the Portfolio Manager.

    Before You Begin: Requirements & Metadata

    To ensure your photos are approved successfully, you must meet our technical and content requirements. Please review our guide on Photos: Item Preparation & Technical Requirements before you start.

    Metadata

    The Portfolio Manager automatically reads the title, description, and tags directly from your photo's metadata.

    • Embed your metadata first: To make your workflow more efficient, always embed the title, description, and tags into your photo's metadata before uploading.
    • The metadata title is key: The title assigned in the metadata will be used, regardless of the actual file name.
    • You can also bulk apply metadata via CSV. For an example of the photo CSV, click here. 

    Technical Requirements Checklist

    An item cannot be submitted for review until it meets these minimum requirements:

    • A Title (under 100 characters)
    • A Description
    • At least 1 and no more than 50 Author Tags
    • RGB color format
    • JPG or JPEG file format
    • Resolution between 4 and 80 Megapixels

    How to Upload Photos

    Once you've met the requirements above, you can follow these steps to submit your items to Portfolio Manager:

    To submit your items using Portfolio Manager:

    1. Sign in to Portfolio Manager (https://portfolio.envato.com/).
    2. Upload your items by browsing files or using the Drag and drop feature.
    3. Select Edit on your uploaded item to complete the required metadata fields.
    4. When your items are ready to submit, tick the agreement box confirming you hold all necessary legal rights and valid releases.
    5. Select Submit to send your item for review.

    See our guide on How to Upload and Submit in the new Portfolio Manager for step-by-step instructions on uploading, editing and submitting your items.

    Uploading items via FTP

    To upload graphics items via FTP, please follow the below steps. Please note, this is not currently available for 3D on Elements, or animated graphics. 

    Please note: you will need to have an FTP client installed before following the processes below. We recommend FileZilla’s FTP client and have documented the process using this third-party software. However, you may be more familiar with and are welcome to use an alternative FTP client.

    You’ll need an API key to use as your password for FTP upload. If you haven’t got this yet, simply:

    • Visit https://build.envato.com/create-token/
    • Choose a token name
    • In the permissions list below, make sure to check ‘View and search Envato sites’ and ‘View your Envato Account username’.
    • Then, click Create Token

    Once you have done this, please follow the below steps.

    1. Open your FTP client and enter the following details:

    • Host: http://ftp.aws.portfolio.envato.com/ 
    • Username: [your Envato username] (this is case-sensitive)
    • Password: [your Envato API key]
    • Port: 21
    • Encryption: Use explicit FTP over TLS
    • Click 'Connect' or your FTP client equivalent.

    2. Drag your files into the upload area of the FTP client. There will be designated folders for the specific content type you are uploading - please ensure you upload to this folder specifically.  You can also upload your metadata CSV this way. 

    3. Wait for your files to process, and then close your FTP client.

    4. Return to Portfolio Manager to review your uploaded files.

  • 3D

    Here, we explain how to get your 3D items uploaded to Envato Market and Envato Elements.

    Upload 3D Items on Envato Market

    Upload 3D Items on Envato Elements

    3D on Envato Market

    1. Please familiarize yourself with the 3D Item Preparation & Technical Requirements to ensure your submissions are successfully approved.
    2. Login at 3DOcean.net (If you aren’t immediately directed to your dashboard, you can use this link: https://3docean.net/author_dashboard).

    3. Select the relevant item type from the dropdown list on the right, under ‘Upload an item’.

    4. Fill in the required information on this page. You can find more information about the item preparation and required metadata here: https://help.author.envato.com/hc/en-us/articles/360000471943-How-to-Upload-Your-Items-to-Envato.

    5. Check that you have completed all relevant fields, including setting a price, and have uploaded the required files. Once everything has been completed, you must read and tick the acknowledgement, if it’s accurate for you, then you can click ‘Upload’.

    6. Job done! Your item will now be in our queue, awaiting review by our team. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

    3D on Envato Elements

    All 3D items can be uploaded through the Portfolio Manager. Here, we explain how to get your 3D items to Envato Elements.

    Before You Begin: Requirements & Metadata

    To ensure your 3D items are approved successfully, you must meet our technical and content requirements. Please review our guide on 3D Item Preparation & Technical Requirements  before you start.

    Technical Requirements Checklist

    An item cannot be submitted for review until it meets these minimum requirements:

    • A Title (under 100 characters)
    • A Description
    • Item Tags (minimum of 1 tag & maximum of 50 tags)
    • OBJ, FBX, GLTF, or GLB file format for 3D Models
    • .mat, .ma, .rib, or .oth file format for shader and material for 3D Models
    • Spline 3D or Blender file format for 3D templates.

    How to Upload 3D items

    Once you've met the requirements above, you can follow these steps to submit your items to Portfolio Manager:

results.name: Setting Your Elements Payout Method
results.title: Setting Your Elements Payout Method
results.body:
Summary: This article outlines everything you need to know about our payout system, including how to set up your payout profile and choose the payout option that best suits your needs.

 

What are the benefits of our payout system? 

Our payout experience provides Authors with access to a wide range of payment options, flexibility, smooth transfers and potentially low fees. Our goal is to support our Author community with a positive payout experience to help them succeed with their creative endeavors.

We have opted to include a wide range of payout options to best support our Authors, as not everyone’s preferred method will be the same. The system provides all the common payout methods such as PayPal and bank transfers, as well as additional options for Local Currency payments.

We also wanted to simplify the payout process and give our Authors the ability to self-serve when making changes to their account details. For example, Authors can add or update a new Payoneer account in the same way as other payout methods, reducing the need to contact Author Support.

In summary, our payout system offers a range of benefits to our Authors including:

  • An option to receive local currency at a low fee
  • More control over the way they're paid
  • Additional payout options
  • Faster transfers
  • Streamlined payout setup and onboarding

Please note: If you've already set up a payout profile for Market, you are not required to set up a separate profile for Elements.

How do I ensure I get paid?

To make sure we can process your payments you will need to set up your payout details before the 8th of the month. Otherwise your payment will be processed the following month.

Complete your ID check to get paid

To receive your payout, you need to complete all onboarding steps, including the Author ID Check. We’re required to verify the identity of every Author, so if your ID Check isn’t complete, we won’t be able to send your payment.

To set up your details, follow these steps:

  1. Access your payout method via https://author.envato.com/profile/payment, or select ‘Payout Method’ when logged in.
  2. Fill out your General Information. Start by filling out your personal or business details. You will need to enter up-to-date and complete information here. The payment system is not integrated to your Envato profile so do not assume that your tax form information will be auto-filled. Once you have filled out your general information, you will be directed to select a Payout Method. Note: do not enter a bank branch address under General Information.
  3. Set your Payout method–either Bank Transfer or PayPal. If you want to select a virtual provider like Payoneer, Wise or Revolut, you need to select the Bank Transfer option. 
    1. Bank Transfer (which may include, depending on your location and bank: IACH, SWIFT bank wires, USD to USD SWIFT wires or a virtual provider).
    2. PayPal

Make sure that your account holder name and address match the details on your payout account, as well as on your Envato account. Payments to another person are not allowed. If these details don't align, we may not be able to send your payout.

Please note: if your residential address is located in Russia, Belarus, Afghanistan, Sudan, or Libya, we will not be able to pay you. 

How do I select and set up a bank transfer?

Envato now offers bank transfers into 137 currencies, 83 of which are transferred via local routes called International Automated Clearing Houses (IACHs). These are cross-border transfer services that enable electronic transfer payments using your local currency. This means faster payouts and fewer fees.

If your bank account is in your country’s local currency, you will receive a same-currency transfer. This means that foreign exchange charges will not be applied by your bank, and you can better predict the final amount you will receive. 

Landing times for local currency payments are typically within 1-2 business days, as opposed to 5 business days with the SWIFT network.

Please note: You must ensure you are entering the country of your bank account.

Selecting to be paid via Money Transfer (such as Payoneer)

Receiving your money through a Money Transfer provider, such as Wise and Payoneer, is one of the many ways you can be paid in our system.

A Money Transfer provider is a way for Authors to receive payouts in the United States dollar (USD) or in euro (EUR). 

Our payout provider facilitates a transfer into a receiving account for a particular currency which enables us to support many other payment methods as well as support other money transfer providers (in addition to Payoneer).

How do I ensure I get paid via MTP?

In order to set up a transfer via Payoneer or any other US transfer provider, you will need to follow the below process. Please note, you will be required to provide your virtual routing account information to receive your funds. 

Log into your Payoneer account:

  1. Navigate to Get Paid >> Receiving Accounts
  2. Choose your USA account 
  3. Under Account details you'll find your routing number (ABA) and account number

Once you have these details, set up your Envato Author payout method:

  1. Log into your Envato Author account and access your payout method via https://author.envato.com/profile/payment.
  2. Fill out your General Information, and select Next.
  3. Select "Bank Transfer" and select “United States of America” as the bank account country. This is because you are nominating the location of your Payoneer routing account which is in the USA.
  4. Enter the Routing Number (ABA) from your Payoneer account.
  5. Enter the Account Number from your Payoneer account.
  6. Finally, enter the name of the account holder from your Payoneer account.

How to select PayPal

If you would prefer to be paid via PayPal, select PayPal on the 'Select Payment Method' page and enter the email address of a valid PayPal account.

Please note that all PayPal payments are sent in USD.

If you need to change your details and delete a PayPal account, there is a ‘delete’ option on the right hand side.

You can find out more about PayPal's consumer fees for receiving money internationally or domestically here. 

Please note: PayPal does not currently operate in Russia, Belarus, Ukraine and a number of other jurisdictions.

Please contact PayPal if you are unsure about whether payouts to your country are supported.

Frequently Asked Questions

What if I have already done this for Market?

If you've already set up a payout profile for Market, you are not required to set up a separate profile for Elements. If you would like to check your payout details for Market, head to:  https://themeforest.net/accounts/payouts.  

Can you combine my Elements and Market earnings into one monthly payment?

No. As your Market and Elements earnings are separate payments from different entities, and paid on different days, we cannot combine these payments. You will continue to receive one payment from Elements and another payment from Market. 

Can I be paid in USD?

Yes.

If you have selected PayPal, your payments will automatically be processed in USD. 

If you would prefer a bank transfer, but are not in the USA and still want to receive USD, you will need to use a Money Transfer Provider that offers a virtual US routing account, such as Payoneer or Wise. See above for instructions on using Payoneer.

How do I select Payoneer as a payout method?

Payoneer does not appear as a separate option on the Payout Methods page, however, it is listed under the Bank Transfer option.

In order to set a bank transfer via Payoneer, you will need your Payoneer account information. Then follow the steps as outlined in the section: How do I ensure I get paid via MTP?

How do Local Currency payments differ in costs from PayPal or Payoneer?

Local currency conversion is done by our payment provider:

  • before your payments are sent
  • at a fixed rate of 1.9% above the live wholesale rate
  • in your country’s local currency

This also protects you against landing fees as payments sent via local (IACH) routes do not incur these fees. Note that landing fees may still appear for SWIFT transfers, where any receiving fees are applied by your bank and are outside our control.

In comparison, MTP withdrawals in a different currency (e.g. USD) may be subject to conversion fees from both your MTP and your bank. Landing fees are also more likely to happen. We encourage our Authors to evaluate PayPal, Payoneer and bank fees so you can choose the option that best suits your needs.

When will I receive my Elements payout?

You’ll still be paid on the 15th of each month if you have earned more than the minimum payment threshold of $50. This will apply to both your regular Elements earnings as well as any incentives earnings you may be entitled to. 

You should receive payment within 1-3 business days of our payout date.

However, delivery times may vary depending on the method of payment and your location. First time payments (via our new payment system) may also take longer due to compliance requirements. So, for example, a first time bank transfer to certain countries can take up to 7 business days, and a first time Payoneer payment may take up to 10 days.

See the Elements Earnings FAQs for more details on payment dates and minimum payment amounts. 

Why have I been asked to provide documentation?

Before you receive your first payout, you may be required to provide documentation such as proof of income for compliance reasons. If this happens, your earnings statement may be sufficient proof.

If you are based in Bangladesh, and have chosen a direct Bank Transfer, you may be required to fill out a Form C and provide this to your bank. This ensures that your bank is aware that you are receiving an international payment. 

What if I need to change my payout information or method?

If you need to make changes to your Elements payout information, or your payout method, please do so by the 8th of the month. This will ensure that the updates are reflected in your next payout. Changes made after this time may not go into effect until the following month’s payment cycle.

How much do these new payout methods cost?

We are pleased to be able to provide the following payment options at low cost.

Please note: not all options are available to all authors and may depend on your location and financial institution. 

* For a US money transfer, the cost per payment will depend on the payment provider. For example, Payoneer charges approximately 0 -1% of the deposited amount (it depends on the country in which you hold your bank account). Refer to your Money Transfer Provider for details.

Is there a minimum payout amount?

There is a $50 minimum payout amount (for each of the payout methods). If you don't reach the $50 minimum within the month, we will withhold your monies until you reach the minimum.

What happens if I don’t get my payout?

Check that you’ve completed your ID Check. Check that all your details are correct (and that you have listed valid account details). We ask that you take into account the estimated delivery time as outlined above.

Once you’ve confirmed your details and checked the delivery estimate, you can raise a support ticket.

Can I get an FIRC Document? 

A Foreign Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) is a document that acts as proof of a foreign transfer to India. Please note that we are not able to provide FIRC Documents to authors. 


If you require a certificate, please reach out to your beneficiary (receiving) bank. While setting up your payment profile and choosing your Currency, please consider whether the availability of FIRC documents impacts your setup. Your bank may not be able to provide FIRC documents for all currency transfers.

If you have followed the above steps and still have questions, please reach out to our Author Support team.

results.name: Elements Earnings FAQs
results.title: Elements Earnings FAQs
results.body:
• When are my earnings paid?

    We pay out your earnings into your nominated account on the 15th of the month if it is a weekday. If the 15th falls on a weekend, your earnings will be paid on the following Monday. To be eligible for a payout on the 15th, you must have set up your payout account at least two business days before the payout day.

    Due to our revenue share methodology, there is a necessary delay before we can calculate author earnings. The reason is that we need to wait until an individual subscription period has finished and no more downloads can occur before we can determine the earnings value of those downloads.

    For example, your earnings relating to subscriptions that started in February will be paid on 15th April. Those subscriptions may include downloads in either February or March, depending on the individual subscribers start and end dates.

    There is a minimum payout threshold of USD $50 that applies to your earnings, as per the author agreement.

    Your earnings on Envato are always displayed in US dollars, and will be paid to you in US dollars unless you select a payout method that includes local currency conversion. If receiving USD, please check if your financial institution does any currency conversion and whether charge you additional fees (we don’t control either the conversion rates or your financial institution’s fees).

    When your payout is sent, you will receive an email with the estimated date that your payout will reach your account. This may be delayed, however if you haven't received your payout three business days after the estimated arrival date, please contact Author Support.

     

  • What payment methods do you support?

    We support payment via PayPal or Bank Transfer; Bank transfer includes local currency options or SWIFT wire depending on your country, and money transfer accounts like Wise, Revolut or Payoneer. You can read more about these in our Understanding Earnings on Envato Elements and Setting up your Elements Payout Method articles.

results.name: The Envato Author Glossary
results.title: The Envato Author Glossary
results.body:
Summary: This glossary will help to guide you through the important terminology, concepts and definitions (including examples) that will be relevant to you as you begin to create and sell items on Envato Platforms.

*Top Tip: Try pressing Control F (or Command F on Mac) on your keyboard to ‘find’ specific keywords in this document!

Since Envato offers a range of platforms, including Envato Market, Envato Elements and Placeit across a wide variety of products (or content types) such as Code Scripts, Video, Music & Audio, Website Themes, Design Assets, Stock Photos and 3D Models, there are certain concepts, terms and definitions that are unique to Envato and have different meanings to what is standard.

Here, we’ve created an Author glossary organised using the categories of the Help Center. This means that if you’re exploring a particular section and looking for some more clarity on specific words or processes we’re talking about, you can easily navigate to the specific section when and where you need it.

This is all part of ensuring that we can better explain and support our global community to navigate our ecosystem. If you’re new to Envato or just need a refresher, please take some time to get to know us through our Author Glossary.

If we’ve missed anything or if you'd like some support, please let us know by reaching out or navigate through our articles by category for more information.

  • 1. Getting Started with Envato

    Username

    This is your author name created when you first created your Envato Account. You can change your author name up to three times.

    Envato Market Account

    This is where you upload and manage your items and account on Envato Market.

    Envato Elements Account

    This is where you sell and manage your items (and sometimes upload depending on your content type) and account on Envato Elements.

    Content Type

    Also known as Item Type and Asset Type, Content Type refers to the primary medium/content of your item. For example, Video, Audio, Graphics, Themes, Photos and 3D are all content types. Making sure your item is placed in the right content type makes your item more easily discoverable for customers.

    Category

    Category is the next level down from your Content Type and refers to the specific category that your content lives in. For example, if your Content Type is Graphics, the categories underneath that might be vectors, textures, icons, backgrounds, etc. This extra level of categorization helps customers to filter through and find the items they are looking for within the specific content type.

    Platforms

    Also known as Shop Fronts, platforms refer to the platforms available within the Envato Ecosystem. For example, alongside our most established platform Envato Market, we also have Envato Elements, Placeit, and Envato Tuts+ as our platforms.

    Marketplaces

    This refers to the individual marketplaces (and content types) available specifically through Envato Market, such as:

    • ThemeForest for Web Themes & Templates
    • AudioJungle for Audio & Music
    • VideoHive for Video Templates & Stock Video
    • PhotoDune for Stock Photos
    • GraphicRiver for Graphic Fonts, Logos, Icons, Templates and more
    • CodeCanyon for Code Script Items
    • 3DOcean for 3D Print Models and CG Textures

    Authors

    Also known as Sellers and Creators, Envato Authors are our talented community members who sell and earn using our Envato platforms. Envato Authors come in all shapes and sizes, whether they are a hobbyist, a small to medium sized business or a large enterprise.

    Customers

    Also known as Subscribers on Envato Elements (being our subscription platform), they are our community of active users who purchase creative items on our Envato platforms, whether that's once-off or recurring across our Envato ecosystem.

    Users

    This is often used to describe both Customers and Authors, who use, sell, buy and operate using our Envato platforms.

    Profile Page

    This is the place where you can share a little bit about yourself and your brand. It’s a great place to market yourself and your items to potential customers.

    Author Dashboard

    The Author Dashboard is the starting point to upload your items, manage your profile and complete your tax information. It is accessed through Envato Market and it will help to navigate you to various Author resources.

  • 2. Item Quality and Technical Requirements

    File Preparation

    This refers to the process of preparing a file (before it can become an item) so that it meets our technical requirements, both general (to Envato) and specific (to the content type).

    Item Quality

    This refers to the degree to which an item meets our specific set of requirements. Envato’s Item Quality expectations are overarching standards that are assessed across these main requirements that we look for during the review process:

    Item Information

    Also known as item metadata and attributes, refers to the important information that an Author needs to include when uploading an item to sell on Envato. Item information (which includes tags, titles, and item description) helps to provide context to customers about the item. It also helps in search and discovery so your item can get found by the customers searching for it.

    Item Presentation

    This refers to the important marketing aspect of selling an item online and is all about how an item looks to a customer. Item Presentation (which includes cover images, preview images, live previews, watermarks - where applicable) helps attract customers by showcasing all the features of your item. The more attractive it looks, the more it can appeal to customers looking for an item to purchase.

    Technical Requirements

    This refers to how the item works and ensuring that it is free of errors and meets customer expectations to be able to use the item. As this can differ depending on what is required, there are technical requirements provided for each content type.

    Legal Requirements

    This refers to how compliant the item is across our Envato terms. We look to make sure items are free of any offensive materials and potential copyright or trademark issues.

    Review

    To ensure that items submitted during the upload process meet our quality expectations, we have a review process which assesses items across our requirements. When items are uploaded and submitted for review, they are assessed by our qualitative team with an approval, soft or hard rejection.

    Review time

    This refers to the current average wait times (across content types) based on the queue (of items submitted) and the available resources of our reviewers.

    Approved Items

    If an item is approved through the review process, it is defined as an approved item and it is published immediately.

    Hard Rejected Items

    If an item is hard rejected, this means that the Quality team has determined that the item is not suitable for sale on Envato. This can be for a number of reasons but generally, it means that the item is not at the quality level required or it has breached legal content guidelines. Hard rejected items cannot be resubmitted.

    Soft Rejected Items

    If soft rejected, this means that the item is almost ready to go, however it still needs a few more changes before it can be published! Feedback about the item will be provided to the Author through an automated email and notes in their Author Dashboard and the item can then be resubmitted (once applying the changes requested). Please note that this is not available for photo items.

    Assets

    This refers to the smaller components that form part of your item, like the photo used in the preview of your Theme item or a music track within your Video item. Your item is the whole product you are making available on Envato to be licensed to your customers.

    Item States

    This refers to the state your item is in during the review process. On Envato Market it could include: Approved/Published, Soft-Rejected, Hard-Rejected, Soft-Disabled and Hard-Disabled. On Envato Elements, it could include: Draft, Changes Required and Rejected.

    Approval Ratio

    You may see an approval ratio mentioned when we talk about submission limits across different item types. This number is determined by how many items you submit divided by how many items are approved. So if you submit your first ever 10 items and 5 are approved, then your overall approval ratio would be 50%. Please note that the amount of items or the time period that the ratio is calculated across, may change across different submission limits.

  • 3. Uploading your Items and Portfolio Management

    Item(s)

    Also known as Assets, Creative Assets and Content, an item is the final product that is sold and marketed through Envato Platforms. It is what customers see on the site prior to their purchase and what they receive post-purchase. They are uploaded and sold on our platforms based on meeting our quality and technical requirements.

    Item Submission

    This refers to the process of submitting or uploading your item for our review process to sell on Envato. This takes place in the upload page (once an item’s information and presentation requirements like the category and attributes, tags, title, preview images, etc. have been added) and then it is then uploaded.

    Item Page

    The item page is the place where your item is displayed once it has been reviewed and approved. This is where you can include all your item information and presentation, including a description and images.

    Upload Page

    The upload page is the place where you upload your items. It can depend on your content type (or what platform you’re contributing to), but the majority of item submissions take place here.

    Uploading

    This refers to the process of submitting your item(s) to Envato for review. This takes place in the upload page.

    Bulk Upload

    Also known as a bulk submission, this refers to the process of uploading multiple / bulk items for review, instead of one by one.

    Publishing

    Also known as live, this refers to the process of an item being made available for sale on the platform after successfully passing review.

  • 4. Payments & Taxes

    Earnings

    This is the money you receive (as an Author), after any fees and taxes, from the sales you make on Envato.

    Item points

    These are points assigned to different item types to help weight them in terms of complexity. They are used as part of our Subscriber Share model on Envato Elements to determine Author earnings.

    Earnings Dashboard

    Also known as an Earnings Report, this is a visual representation of your earnings (item sales) that is made available for logged in Authors in either their Market profile, or via the Elements App.

    Subscriber Share / Revenue Share

    Subscriber share is the revenue share methodology we use on Envato Elements. With subscriber share, your earnings as an Author are directly linked to the money collected from each individual subscriber's plan. We look at each subscriber and assign you with a share of 50% of the net revenue from the base subscription price for their plan, based on how important your items were to them (i.e your share of all item points they used in that period).

    Sales

    A sale happens when an item you're selling on Envato Market has been purchased - congratulations! Sales are recorded on your statement along with information to tell you exactly which item was purchased and the amount it was purchased for.

    Purchase

    A purchase happens when you buy an item license from an author selling on Envato Market. The total price paid by the customer is made up of the license price which is paid to the Author, and a payment for Envato’s customer services called a Buyer Fee. Using the shopping cart you can make multiple purchases in a single checkout.

    Order

    An order is made up of one or more purchases. Every time you complete the checkout process on the Envato Market, we assign an order ID to all transactions that were completed as part of the checkout process.

    For example, if you have purchased multiple items in a single shopping cart, the item licences and buyer fees will all have the same unique order ID. Your order may also be subject to a handling fee charge, depending on your payment method and order total.

    Payout

    A payout is when you request a withdrawal of your Envato Market earnings. This is shown as a payout on your statement.

    Nominated Payout Account

    This is your chosen account that your earnings from Envato are delivered to on a monthly basis.

    Reversals & Refunds

    A reversal happens when a purchase is refunded or reversed as a result of a chargeback. A reversal always appears on a customer's statement along with an accompanying credit note. For some types of refunds such as author-initiated refunds, the author’s statement will show the reversal and the related credit note.

    In other cases, when the refund is marked as a ‘goodwill’ refund from Envato, the author’s statement and balance will be unchanged and the credit note will be generated from Envato to the customer.

    Referral Income

    When a new user clicks a referral link (generated through the Envato Market Affiliate Program) with your account details and has not previously followed a referral link, then signs up for an account and purchases an item (or adds credit) via any of the Envato Market sites, you will receive a commission equivalent to 30% of that person's first credit or purchase.This is displayed as a referral on your statement.

    Receipt

    A receipt is generated when you add credit to your Envato Market account in exchange for Envato credit.

    Invoice

    An invoice is generated for the sale of every item or service on Envato Market. The Invoice will show the following information; date, invoice ID, order ID, seller's details, customer's details, item details (the details of the item purchased (including Item name, Item ID, license type, size if applicable (e.g. on PhotoDune), and item price)), and total (in USD). For convenience, services to authors are aggregated into a single monthly service fee invoice.

    Service Fee Invoice

    Every month authors will receive a single aggregated invoice for all Author Fees during that period.

    Statement

    Your statement is a list of all transactions and any activity that has altered your account balance. It contains information on all your sales, purchases, credits, withdrawals, referral program earnings and reversals.

    Credit Note

    A credit note is when a reversal of an invoice occurs (negative invoice). When an invoice has been generated and the transaction is cancelled or voided, a credit note is issued to support it.

    Total Price

    When you make a purchase, the total price you pay will be made up of the Item Price for the item license, and Envato’s Customer and Handling Fees (if applicable).

    Item Price

    When you make a purchase, the price paid for the item license to the author of that item is called the Item Price.

    Handling Fee

    A handling fee may apply if the “Buy Now” (PayPal) payment method is used. Handling fees are charged per order (not per item).

    List Price

    This is the price you see on an item page, and includes the Item Price and Buyer Fee.

    Author Fee

    When you make a sale on Envato Market, you are charged a 50% Author Fee by Envato for use of our platform and services.

    Buyer Fee

    This is similar to an Author Fee, but on the Customer side. It’s the fee paid to Envato for use of our platform and services. This includes services like 24/7 customer support, fraud protection, and item quality control.

  • 5. Your Envato Account

    API Key

    An API Key is a security token that you can use to authenticate with our API. It is a secret, like a password, that should be protected.

    Two Factor Authentication

    This is an extra layer of security that helps to protect your Envato account. When you have two-factor authentication on your account you will be asked to enter an authentication code in addition to your username and password when logging in.

    Backup Codes

    These are one-time use codes that will enable you to gain access to your account when you don’t have access to your mobile device. Your backup codes are automatically generated when you first set up two-factor authentication.

    Account Credentials

    These refer to the private account details used to create your Envato Account, such as your username and password.

    Phishing / Scams

    Sometimes, strangers might be trying to lure you into sharing your account credentials by pretending to be Envato, when in fact they are not associated with Envato at all. These types of attempts are commonly referred to as "phishing" and the perpetrators are called "phishers."

    Deactivation

    This refers to the process of removing or deleting a user account if it has been requested that we do so.

    6. Policies, Terms and Licenses

    License

    When you ‘sell’ an item, you’re making your item available to customers to use that item under certain conditions; you’re not actually selling the item itself. What a customer can and cannot do with the item depends on which type of license they get. There are a number of different license for Envato Market depending on the type of item, and a different license for Envato Elements items too.

results.body:
Summary: Coding standards ensure quality and continuity in your code. The iOS and Swift coding standards have been listed below. 

Use Xcode

Xcode is the IDE of choice for most iOS developers, and the only one officially supported by Apple. There are a few alternatives, of which AppCode is possibly the most famous, but unless you are already an iOS expert, opt for Xcode. 

CocoaPods

If you're planning on including external dependencies (e.g. third-party libraries) in your project, CocoaPods offers easy and fast integration. 

Coding Conventions

Methods defined in Cocoa frameworks-for example, Foundation, AppKit, and UIKit-behave in certain ways under different circumstances. For example:

  • Methods that return objects typically return nil if they cannot create or find the object. They do not directly return a status code.
  • Methods that perform an operation return a boolean value to indicate success or failure.
  • If a method takes a collection object-that is, an NSArray, NSDictionary, or NSSet object-as an argument, do not specify nil to indicate "default" or "no value"; instead, pass an empty collection object.
  • If you explicitly manage program memory, follow memory management guidelines and practices.

The following is a sample of API naming conventions:

  • Clarity and brevity are important, but never sacrifice clarity for brevity.
  • Avoid ambiguous names.
  • Use verbs in method or function names that represent actions.
  • Use prefixes for class names and for symbols associated with classes, such as functions and data types.

Further recommended reading:

https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/documentation/General/Conceptual/DevPedia-CocoaCore/CodingConventions.html

results.name: Android App Requirements
results.title: Android App Requirements
results.body:
Summary: This article outlines Android App requirements. 

References:

  • https://developer.android.com/jetpack
  • https://developer.android.com/kotlin

Note: It is strongly recommended that your Android apps follow the Java and Kotlin Coding standards.

  • Apps must not have any redundant variables or methods (except if such variables and methods are meant to help adding further features).
  • Apps must close all streams used in  a finally clause when using the try-catch blocks.
  • Apps must not have hardcoded credentials for passwords or usernames.
  • If the app handles payment methods, it must have reliable 3rd party libraries.
  • Conditionals must evaluate different elements and must not always return true or false.

For example:

if (true)

while(true)

if( x>0 && x>0)

  • The code must cast the variables correctly to perform any arithmetic operation.
  • All strings used must be in the strings.xml file.
  • Variables must be local whenever possible, avoid using globals.
  • The app must have at least android API level 29 according to the new Playstore requirements.

Note: It is a good practice to use a code quality testing tool like sonarqube.

https://www.sonarqube.org/sonarqube-8-1/?gclid=EAIaIQobChMI3ZO-69Pv5wIVRr7ACh3-zAQsEAAYAiAAEgLzofD_BwE

results.name: Account Security FAQs
results.title: Account Security FAQs
results.body:
• Help! I think my account has been taken over?

    If you believe that your account has been compromised or accessed without your authorization, please contact the Envato Support Team immediately.

    If you can log into your account:

    1. Change your password.
    2. Change the password to the email address associated with your Envato account.
    3. Verify your other account information.

    If you are unable to log into your account: 
    Please contact the Envato Support Team with the following information:

    1. Your username
    2. The time and date of your last successful login
    3. A description of the unusual activity
    4. The names of your latest purchases or sales
    5. Details of recent payouts (e.g. payout amount and email address or bank details attached to the payment)

    Please note: We do not permit account sharing as stated in our terms and conditions.

  • What do I do If I’m locked out of my account?

    Security precautions are a necessary part of any platform, and at Envato, we take account security very seriously. While the process of locking accounts can be frustrating, our aim is to protect you and provide a safe online experience for our community at large.

    We recommend you to check the following before contacting us for support:

    • Double check your payment method (whether it's PayPal or credit card). Depending on which method you're currently using, you'll want to contact them first to make sure it's not caused by their system, to begin with, as this might lead to duplicate behavior, and you being locked out repeatedly even after we've already unlocked the account.
    • Please make sure you're not changing or sharing payment details with other people.
    • If you are unhappy with something you’ve purchased, please contact us before opening a PayPal or credit card dispute. Any PayPal or credit card dispute will automatically result in your account being locked as a security precaution and this can take much longer to resolve than contacting us first.

    If none of the above pointers helped, follow these steps outlined and we’ll get you on your way as quickly as possible:

    1. Get in touch with us ASAP via this link.
    2. Please make sure to select the correct category from the drop-down - Being an Author and My Account > My account is locked.
    3. Be sure to include your Envato Account username, and a brief description of what happened before you got locked out (e.g: "I tried to buy this item - the PayPal transaction went through, now I'm locked out!!!").

    Following the above steps will not only allow us to react more swiftly but also to improve this process moving forward.

    Please note: If you have opened up a dispute by the time you've read this, please drop us a line via the help form and we'll guide you from there.

  • Why haven't I received the sign-in verification email?

    Use these instructions to troubleshoot if you have not received a sign in verification email:

    Step 1. Please check the following areas below:

    • You’ve entered your email address correctly.
    • The email is not in your spam or junk folder.
    • Your domain is not filtering or blocking the email.
    • You do not have an email forwarding setup.

    Step 2. Add do-not-reply@envato.com to your address book or Contacts, or whitelist this email address.

    Step 3. If you have checked all of the above and you still haven't received the verification email please get in touch with our Support Team.

    Please note: Custom domains often have filtering or spam features which can prevent email delivery. You could try signing up for an email account with Gmail, Yahoo, Outlook or Hotmail to get around this

    For more information around the Sign In Verification process, please see how it works here.

  • Why am I receiving a 'Google Chrome Download Warning'?

    Recently, some Google Chrome users have been experiencing an alert message when downloading files from Envato Market.

    filename.zip is not commonly downloaded and could be dangerous.

    All items are thoroughly checked by our Quality Team, to ensure they are free from malware or any other dangerous material before they are approved for sale.

    We believe this isn't an Envato-side issue as it has been reported by other companies as well.

  • What are some tips for keeping my Envato account secure?

    Use a strong password:

    • Create a strong, unique password - do not reuse passwords from other sites.
    • Use a long password - longer passwords are harder to guess.
    • Choose a password with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols.

    Store your password securely:

    • Store password reminders in a safe place.
    • Password managers like LastPass, Password Genie 4.0, 1Password or Dashlane keep all your passwords safe and automatically generate strong passwords for you.

    Public computer usage:

    • Be sure to always log out after accessing your account on a public computer.
    • When you change your password on your Envato Account, a colored bar indicates if your password is weak, medium or strong. If it’s weak we suggest you change it!

results.name: Isolated Objects Requirements
results.title: Isolated Objects Requirements
results.body:
Summary: This article outlines the requirements for photos of isolated objects.

Please refer to the following guidelines when submitting photos of isolated objects.

  • High-quality photos of isolated objects are acceptable.
    • Photos of isolated objects must be properly and cleanly isolated.
    • Isolated objects in the photo must not have overly soft or rough edges.
    • Isolated objects in the photo must not have edges that don’t match the subject/background or fit with the overall image depth of field.
    • Photos must not contain any erasing artifacts, leftover background areas / spots, or background coloration as a result of the isolation.
    • Do not submit isolated objects of images with a short depth of field, that result in a softer object with mismatched sharp edges.
    • Subtle and naturally occurring shadows are acceptable (e.g., for objects photographed on a white background).
  • Acceptable methods of isolating objects include:
    • High-quality background removal/erasing (e.g., clipping path)
    • Objects photographed on white background and isolated by lighting
    • High quality keyed photos (e.g., originally shot on greenscreen)
  • Images with multiple isolated elements should be separated and submitted individually as full resolution photos.
    • An exception may be made if the image is intended as a composite / collage, where all the elements are related and work well together to create a single cohesive image and concept. If so, the image must also follow the additional requirements for photo composites.

results.name: Flutter App Requirements
results.title: Flutter App Requirements
results.body:
Summary: This article outlines the Flutter App requirements.

Technical Requirements

Lists and grids must use lazy loading to display the data, using the builder methods of container widgets to do so.

Listview.builder()

See more information in the official docs here:

  • Working with long lists in the Cookbook
  • Creating a ListView that loads one page at a time a community article by AbdulRahman AlHamali

When the widget tree gets big enough you must use a state management alternative when sending data from a parent widget to its grandchildren or vice versa.

You can use bloc, redux, provider package libraries, etc.

  • https://pub.dev/packages/provider
  • https://api.flutter.dev/flutter/widgets/InheritedWidget-class.html
  • https://www.freecodecamp.org/news/how-to-handle-state-in-flutter-using-the-bloc-pattern-8ed2f1e49a13/

The main.dart file must not be very extensive.

You must declare routes, themes and other initial configuration variables in separate files for this.

Custom widgets must be as short as possible to have a modular app.

You must divide a widget into smaller ones and replace chunks of code with functions that return a widget.

For example:

Dart classes must use private methods and variables and they must be final whenever possible unless it is strictly necessary to use globals.

For example:

final _variable;
Widget _methodName() {...}

Flutter apps must use stateless widgets whenever possible except when it’s strictly necessary to use stateful widgets.

The quality of flutter apps can be verified by using the ‘flutter analyze’ command from the Flutter SDK as shown below:

  • In the root folder of the flutter project run flutter analyze

With the release of Flutter 2.0 have to make sure your project does not throw any errors or warnings when executing the flutter analyze command in the previous point, if so, please update all of your flutter dependencies.

If your flutter app uses the web capabilities of the framework, make sure all the libraries are compatible with web browsers since not all the pub packages are 100% compatible.

Before submitting your app for our review make sure to run flutter clean command to erase all the unnecessary files and code.

results.name: Setting up your Payout profile
results.title: Setting up your Payout profile
results.body:
Summary: This article outlines everything you need to know about our payout system, including how to set up your payout profile and choose the payout option that best suits your needs. This is for both Elements and Market payouts: we have one payment system for all author payments. 

Our payout experience provides Authors with access to a wide range of payment options, flexibility, smooth transfers and potentially low fees. While the options available to you depend on your country of residence, we offer;

  • Options to receive your local currency via bank transfer at a low fee
  • PayPal
  • USD Wire transfers
  • Payoneer, Wise and other Money Transfer providers 
  • Mobile wallets in over 30+ countries

How do I set up a payout profile?

To make sure we can process your payments you will need to set up your payout details before the 8th of the month. Otherwise your payment will be processed the following month.

Complete your ID check to get paid

To receive your payout, you need to complete all onboarding steps, including the Author ID Check. We’re required to verify the identity of every Author, so if your ID Check isn’t complete, we won’t be able to send your payment.

To set up your details, follow these steps:

  1. Access your payout method via your author dashboard and click ‘ Payout Method’ in the "Manage your Profile" section
  2. Fill out your General Information. Start by filling out your personal or business details. You will need to enter up-to-date and complete information here. The payment system is not integrated to your Envato profile so do not assume that your tax form information will be auto-filled. Once you have filled out your general information, you will be directed to select a Payout Method. Note: do not enter a bank branch address under General Information. 
  3. Set your Payout method –. If you want to select a virtual provider like Payoneer, Wise or Revolut, you need to select the Bank Transfer option. 
    1. Bank Transfer (which may include, depending on your location and bank: IACH, SWIFT bank wires, USD to USD SWIFT wires or a virtual provider)
    2. PayPal
    3. Mobile wallet (in select countries) 

Make sure that your account holder name and address match the details on your payout account, as well as on your Envato account. Payments to another person are not allowed. If these details don't align, we may not be able to send your payout.

Please note: if your residential address is located in Russia, Belarus, Afghanistan, Sudan, or Libya, we will not be able to pay you. 

Bank Transfers

Envato offers bank transfers into 137 currencies, 83 of which are transferred via local routes called International Automated Clearing Houses (IACHs). These are cross-border transfer services that enable electronic transfer payments using your local currency. This means faster payouts and fewer fees.

If your bank account is in your country’s local currency, you will receive a same-currency transfer. This means that foreign exchange charges will not be applied by your bank, and you can better predict the final amount you will receive. 

Landing times for local currency payments are typically within 1-2 business days, as opposed to 5 business days with the SWIFT network.

Please note: You must ensure you are entering the country of your bank account.

Money Transfers (Payoneer, Wise etc)

Receiving your money through a Money Transfer provider, such as Wise and Payoneer, is one of the many ways you can be paid in our system.

A Money Transfer provider is a way for Authors to receive payouts in the United States dollar (USD) or in Euro (EUR). You must ensure you enter in an account that can accept your chosen currency; ie if you select USD then make sure you have the details of your USD receiving account. 

How do I set up a Money Transfer Provider?

In order to set up a transfer via Payoneer or any other US transfer provider, you will need to select the Bank Transfer option in our system and then add your virtual routing account information to receive your funds. 

 Payoneer: Log into your Payoneer account and;

  1. Navigate to Get Paid >> Receiving Accounts
  2. Choose your USA account 
  3. Under Account details you'll find your routing number (ABA) and account number

Once you have these details, set up your Envato Author payout method:

  1. Log into your Envato Author account and access your payout method via https://author.envato.com/profile/payment.
  2. Fill out your General Information, and select Next.
  3. Select "Bank Transfer" and select “United States of America” as the bank account country. This is because you are nominating the location of your Payoneer routing account which is in the USA.
  4. Enter the Routing Number (ABA) from your Payoneer account.
  5. Enter the Account Number from your Payoneer account.
  6. Finally, enter the name of the account holder from your Payoneer account.
PayPal

Select PayPal on the 'Select Payment Method' page and enter the email address of a valid PayPal account.

Please note that all PayPal payments are sent in USD.

If you need to change your details and delete a PayPal account, there is a ‘delete’ option on the right hand side.

You can find out more about PayPal's consumer fees for receiving money internationally or domestically here. 

Please note: PayPal does not currently operate in Russia, Belarus, Ukraine and a number of other jurisdictions.

Please contact PayPal if you are unsure about whether payouts to your country are supported.

Mobile Wallets

Mobile wallets, sometimes called e-wallets, are only available in certain countries.  If you don't have the mobile wallet option, unfortunately it is not available in your location. 

  1. Select Mobile Wallet on your payout method page
  2. Enter in your Phone or Email identifier associated with your mobile wallet, and click "Add". 

Please note that we can not check or validate your Mobile Wallet information. If you enter in a wallet that does not exist your payment will fail.  Please double check your information is correct. 

Please also note: 

  • We send transfers in USD, but these may be converted to your local currency depending on your mobile wallet. 
  • The conversion rate is determined by the bank at the time of sending with a 2% FX Spread; Envato has no influence over these rates. 
  • A standard 1% of the payout amount fee applies. 

We recommend checking with your wallet provider first so you are not surprised by any conversion or funds or additional fees.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I be paid in USD?

Yes.

If you have selected PayPal, your payments will automatically be processed in USD. 

If you would prefer a bank transfer, but are not in the USA and still want to receive USD, you will need to use a Money Transfer Provider that offers a virtual US routing account, such as Payoneer or Wise. See above for instructions on using Payoneer.

What are the fees?

Please note that these fees are not determined by Envato, and we do not receive them. These are bank determined fees, that Envato has no control over.  

Please note: not all options are available to all authors and may depend on your location and financial institution. 

*For a US money transfer, the cost per payment will also depend on the payment provider. For example, Payoneer charges approximately 0 -1% of the deposited amount (it depends on the country in which you hold your bank account). Refer to your Money Transfer Provider for details.

Can you combine my Elements and Market earnings into one monthly payment?

No, we cannot combine these payments. You will continue to receive one payment from Elements and another payment from Market. 

Can I change my payout method?

You can change your payout method, but you can only nominate one method which will apply to both your Elements and Market payout.

For both Elements and Market, if you already have an existing account, then you can change your details at any time up until the day before pay day up until the 8th of the payout month.

Changes made on or after processing days (15th for Market) may not go into effect until the following month’s payment cycle.

How do I select Payoneer as a payout method?

Payoneer does not appear as a separate option on the Payout Methods page, however, it is listed under the Bank Transfer option.

In order to set a bank transfer via Payoneer, you will need your Payoneer account information. Then follow the steps as outlined in the section: Money Transfer Providers

How do Local Currency payments differ in costs from PayPal or Payoneer?

Local currency conversion is done by our payment provider:

  • before your payments are sent
  • at a fixed rate of 1.9% above the live wholesale rate
  • in your country’s local currency

This also protects you against landing fees as payments sent via local (IACH) routes do not incur these fees. Note that landing fees may still appear for SWIFT transfers, where any receiving fees are applied by your bank and are outside our control.

In comparison, MTP withdrawals in a different currency (e.g. USD) may be subject to conversion fees from both your MTP and your bank. Landing fees are also more likely to happen. We encourage our Authors to evaluate PayPal, Payoneer and bank fees so you can choose the option that best suits your needs.

When will I receive my payout?

Both Market and Elements Payouts are sent on the 15th of each month if you have earned more than the minimum payment threshold of $50 before tax. 

Generally, you should receive payment within 1-3 business days of our payout date. However, delivery times may vary depending on the method of payment and your location. First time payments  may also take longer due to compliance requirements. So, for example, a first time bank transfer to certain countries can take up to 10 business days, and a first time Payoneer payment may take up to one week.

Why have I been asked to provide documentation?

Before you receive your payout, you may be required to provide documentation such as proof of income for compliance reasons. If this happens, your earnings statement may be sufficient proof.

If you are based in Bangladesh, and have chosen a direct Bank Transfer, you may be required to fill out a Form C and provide this to your bank. This ensures that your bank is aware that you are receiving an international payment. 

Is there a minimum payout amount?

There is a $50 minimum payout amount (before any royalty withholding tax). If you don't reach the $50 minimum within the month, your funds will continue to accumulate in your Balance until you reach $50. 

What is a Form C and would I need to submit this to my bank?

A Form C is also known as an "International inward remittance" form. We have been advised that a Form C is required for all ICT (Information, Communication, Technology) transfers to Bangladeshi banks. Envato payments are classed as ICT transfers, so if you are nominating a bank transfer to a Bangladesh Bank you will need to submit the Form C to your bank. 

What happens if I don’t get my payout?

Failed payments will be returned to Envato and be restored to your account balance. We will then attempt to pay them out to you again in the next month. We will send you an email if your payment fails. However if you believe your payment was successful and you haven't received it after the estimated delivery date, follow the below steps. 

  1. If this is your first payment you are expecting, check that you’ve completed your account setup: we can only send payments to authors that have completed their Tax form, Trader status, Payout details and ID check via their dashboard.
  2.  Check that all your details are correct (and that you have listed valid account details).  We cannot validate your bank details for you: if you provide the wrong details or the wrong PayPal account etc, then your payment will fail.
  3. Once you’ve confirmed your details and checked the delivery estimate, if you are still unsure where your payment is,  you can raise a support ticket.
Can I get an FIRC Document? 

A Foreign Inward Remittance Certificate (FIRC) is a document that acts as proof of a foreign transfer to India. Please note that we are not able to provide FIRC Documents to authors. 

If you require a certificate, please reach out to your beneficiary (receiving) bank. While setting up your payment profile and choosing your Currency, please consider whether the availability of FIRC documents impacts your setup. Your bank may not be able to provide FIRC documents for all currency transfers.

 

If you have followed the above steps and still have questions, please reach out to our Author Support team.
